title: A loaded Solarian-born hunter far from home stores its hold at Sol Central and is home again
note: Written by Apophis, 2026-11-24 13:15 UTC (orders ENT-087 P6 and O1; rule F8). At 13:13 UTC a Solarian-born drone waited docked at Haven (Grand Exchange) with 8 units aboard after a mission circuit: every hunt of its row asks an empty hold, store-hold-sol-central (Zero's) opens only within 10 jumps and Haven stands 14 out (fill.py status drone). The same store, for the far ones: up to 18 jumps, after the near route in the list. It brings the ship back to its own region (P6). Standing work: it stores, nothing is sold.
